summary: Verified textual fix on Alberto Pantoja site biography section (#bio): 'San Gabriel del Baba' is now referred to as 'comuna' (not 'parroquia'/'paroisse'/'parish') across all 3 languages (ES/FR/EN). Tested via live URL and language switcher in navbar. All checks PASSED.
